div.head: Grið 21.2
div.ab: We witan, þæt þurh Godes gyfe þræl wearð to ðegene 7 ceorl wearð to eorle, sangere to sacerde 7 bocere to biscpe.
We witan þæt, þurh Godes gyfe, þræl wearð to ðegene and ceorl wearð to eorle, sangere to sacerde and bocere to biscpe.
Wir wissen, dass durch Gottes Gnade ein Knecht zum Vornehmen wurde und ein Gemeiner zum Adligen [Grafen?] wurde, ein Sänger zum Priester und ein Schreiber zum Bischof.
We know that through God's grace a slave became a thegn and a ceorl became a nobleman [earl?], a singer [became] a priest and a scribe a bishop.
We know that, through God’s grace, a slave has become a thane and a commoner become a nobleman, a choir singer become a priest, and a scholar become a bishop.
div.note: The pairs are alliterating, Liebermann notes.
